About

The person behind the camera

My goal is to celebrate life and make our time stand still, even if, just for a moment.

I’m Shawna, the artist and photographer behind Skybyrd, based in Plainfield, Illinois.

I’ve been passionate about photography since 2014, when I first discovered the magic of freezing a fleeting moment in time. What started as a hobby quickly became a calling — a way to help people see the beauty in their everyday lives.

I specialise in family, senior, personal branding and pet photography. Every session is a collaboration: I bring the technical skill and the creative eye, and you bring the authentic moments that make your story yours.

— Shawna

  • Authentic moments

    The most powerful images come from genuine emotion and unscripted joy. The focus is on real connection, not forced poses.

  • Personal connection

    Every session begins with getting to know you. Understanding your story is what makes the images reflect who you actually are.

  • Artistic vision

    A keen eye for light, composition and detail — turning everyday moments into something you will want on the wall.

  1. 2014

    Started photography

    Picked up her first DSLR and fell in love with capturing the world through a lens.

  2. 2018

    First studio

    Opened a small home studio and began offering professional portrait sessions to local families.

  3. 2021

    The Skybyrd brand

    Rebranded as Skybyrd Photography, expanding into seniors, personal branding and pet photography.

  4. 2023

    The Plainfield studio

    Moved into the current studio space, with natural light and modern backdrops.

How a session goes

  1. 01

    Send the form

    Name, email, which session you’re after and roughly when. The message box is the only long bit, and a couple of sentences is plenty.

  2. 02

    I reply within a day

    Always within 24 hours. We’ll talk through location, timing and what to wear.

  3. 03

    A style guide arrives

    Once you book, I send a detailed guide on what to wear and how to prepare.

  4. 04

    The session itself

    Anywhere from 30 minutes for a pet up to three hours for branding. Relaxed and unscripted, built around real moments rather than poses.

  5. 05

    Your gallery, 2–3 weeks later

    A private online link to view, download and share. Rush delivery within 48 hours is available if you need it sooner.

Questions

Questions people ask

What should I wear to my session?

Coordinated outfits in solid colours or subtle patterns photograph best. Avoid large logos or neon colours — earthy tones, pastels and classic neutrals work well. I send a detailed style guide once you book.

How long does a typical session last?

Sessions range from 30 minutes for pets up to two or three hours for personal branding. Most family and senior sessions run about 60 to 90 minutes — enough time to relax, have fun, and capture genuine moments.

When will I receive my photos?

Your online gallery will be ready within two to three weeks. Rush delivery within 48 hours is available as an add-on. You’ll get a link to view, download and share your images.

Do you travel for sessions?

Yes. Based in Plainfield, I travel within 30 miles at no extra charge. For locations beyond that, a small travel fee applies.

What happens if it rains on our outdoor session?

If rain is in the forecast we reschedule at no charge. I watch the weather closely and will reach out 24 hours beforehand to talk through options. Indoor studio sessions are always available too.

I’m not photogenic. Really.

Nobody thinks they are. That is exactly why every session starts with getting to know you rather than posing you — you will forget the camera is there sooner than you expect.

Do I need to pay a deposit to enquire?

No. Sending the form costs nothing and commits you to nothing.

Can we include grandparents or extended family?

Please do. Extended family sessions are frequently the reason people book in the first place.

Write to Me

Questions

Things people ask me

What should I wear to my session?

Coordinated outfits in solid colours or subtle patterns photograph best. Avoid large logos or neon colours — earthy tones, pastels and classic neutrals work well. I send a detailed style guide once you book.

How long does a typical session last?

Sessions range from 30 minutes for pets up to two or three hours for personal branding. Most family and senior sessions run about 60 to 90 minutes — enough time to relax, have fun, and capture genuine moments.

When will I receive my photos?

Your online gallery will be ready within two to three weeks. Rush delivery within 48 hours is available as an add-on. You’ll get a link to view, download and share your images.

Do you travel for sessions?

Yes. Based in Plainfield, I travel within 30 miles at no extra charge. For locations beyond that, a small travel fee applies.

What happens if it rains on our outdoor session?

If rain is in the forecast we reschedule at no charge. I watch the weather closely and will reach out 24 hours beforehand to talk through options. Indoor studio sessions are always available too.

I’m not photogenic. Really.

Nobody thinks they are. That is exactly why every session starts with getting to know you rather than posing you — you will forget the camera is there sooner than you expect.

Do I need to pay a deposit to enquire?

No. Sending the form costs nothing and commits you to nothing.

Can we include grandparents or extended family?

Please do. Extended family sessions are frequently the reason people book in the first place.
